title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #6): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the session mods, the non-wrapper scripts, the daemon CLI commands and the claude-plugin
description:
Filed by the governor at 17:12Z on 2026-11-03. It runs in parallel with hunt #5 (task-b7332618, architect-24611a0a), so the lanes are disjoint. Hunts #2-#4 produced 15 rows today, and most were DONE within an hour. A notification-only architect session can't run a hunt, so the hunt is a claimable row.

WHY. 5 coders and 3 QA seats are idle, with 0 claimable WORKING rows. Only the serial CQ-M07m/n wrapper chain and two hunt-#4 rows remain.

LANE. Search, in this order of preference:
1. scripts/mods/** (moe-account-switch, moe-compaction-keeper), plus scripts/moe-call.sh, scripts/moe-team.{sh,ps1}, scripts/doctor.{sh,ps1} and scripts/install-*.{sh,ps1}. Cases to look for:
   - sh/ps1 twin drift outside moe-agent.*: an argument, exit code, env name or banner one twin handles and the other doesn't;
   - a mod contract that disagrees with the daemon tool it calls (argument names, reply fields such as chat_wait's accountSwitch);
   - a documented behavior in scripts/CLAUDE.md or docs/MCP_SERVER.md "Claude Account Rotation" that the script doesn't implement.
   Before filing, grep .moe/tasks for the file name: the mods already have open or DONE fix rows (e.g. task-16ec5641).
2. packages/moe-daemon/src/commands/** (doctor.ts, doctorWorktree.ts, checkArchitecture.ts) and the CLI entry in packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts: flags, exit codes and output against the root CLAUDE.md "Run" section and docs. Examples: `doctor` exit 0 = green, and check-architecture's exit codes 0/1/2.
3. packages/moe-claude-plugin/src (daemonClient.ts, postToolUse.ts, index.ts): the event and frame shapes it sends against the daemon's /ws handler. Hunt #3 dropped one item as minor: daemonClient.ts:149 and :237 read daemon.json `host`, but the daemon writes `bindHost`. File it only with evidence that it matters, e.g. a hook that never reaches a daemon bound for WSL.

Skip:
- hunt #5's lane: moe-vscode/**, packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/**, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md;
- scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight* and scripts/tests/parity-check.* (the CQ-M07 lane);
- the JetBrains release path, MoeCommandSender.kt / MoeToolWindowPanel.kt (0f2e958f), and docs/SCHEMA.md (b5bfda4d);
- every other file an open row's plan holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.
Already known, so don't re-file: TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line; the account-switch "Background work is running" exit dialog (task-16ec5641); REVIEW claim churn during an all-accounts-spent wait (task-0c78c290).

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#5. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD c4121a4b or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place, and never run a mod or launcher against the live board or a live seat.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For contract drift: the emitter file:line and the consumer file:line, or the doc line and the code file:line.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows QA can check with one test file (vitest, or one scripts/tests harness run).
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD c4121a4b or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or an emitter/consumer (or doc/code) file:line pair.

No filed row targets hunt #5's lane, scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight*, scripts/tests/parity-check.* or a file an open row's plan holds (per lanes.js at hunt time). The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
